extraction.method: deterministic rule/template extraction; items matched on (document, locator)

ground_truth_gaps.note: field mismatches caused by incomplete expected_extraction.json, not by the extractor (ground truth left unchanged). Each one is confirmed by independent evidence, otherwise it counts as an extractor error: `time` is null there but the predicted time equals the truth_events.csv event_time; `area` is null there but the predicted area is written in the source text or the row's Area/Loc cell; two cable rows' expected cells omit the Pulled? cell (the prediction is a superset of the expected evidence)

linking.method: deterministic evidence + stage-2 lexical/attribute retrieval + gated decision; no LLM

calibration.rule: T_auto = lowest auto_min_score with dev auto-link precision >= 0.95 (other gates unchanged)

reliability_test.note: confidence = linker score of the top candidate (a fixed weighting, not a fitted probability)
